image_description: A close-up, high-angle view of a modern electric steam iron against a white background. The iron features a blue and black plastic body with a translucent water tank section near the handle. The soleplate is metallic silver with a pointed tip. A temperature control dial is visible on the top surface.

The rear of the iron where the cord should attach appears fused or melted into the body without a distinct strain relief or plug socket geometry, suggesting a generation error.
The boundary between the metal soleplate and the plastic body is slightly soft and lacks the sharp, hard edge expected in manufactured goods.
